name: Maria Teresa de Filippis
features: olive skin, dark hair tied back under a headscarf, dark eyes, oval face, slight build, broad ready smile
bio: The first woman to race in Formula One. She started in 1948 on a bet with her brothers, driving a Fiat 500 from Salerno to Cava de' Tirreni, and won. Second in the 1954 Italian sports car championship, which brought her a works Maserati seat; her A6GCS retired from the 1955 Mille Miglia. She entered five World Championship Grands Prix in 1958 and 1959, starting at Monaco and finishing tenth at Spa, and remained the only woman to have finished a Grand Prix until Lella Lombardi fifteen years later.
